headline: CrowdStrike (CRWD) Joins Open Source AI Cybersecurity Alliance
summary: CrowdStrike Holdings (NasdaqGS:CRWD) has joined an industry coalition launching an Open Source AI Cybersecurity Alliance. The alliance aims to advance AI security through shared open source tools, frameworks, and standards. The move expands CrowdStrike’s role in AI driven security collaboration beyond its existing partnerships and product work. CrowdStrike is best known for its cloud native endpoint and workload protection platform, and the company has been increasingly vocal about the role...
